game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the knight must hold off mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute banners without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute banners without losing either value. Then check a and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from mischievous imps in Moat Bridge: keep a above zero until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 4, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

hint: Read the code panel: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute banners without losing either value. Keep a above zero until the timer reaches 55.

Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.

Survive for 55 seconds to complete the level.
